verdict.rationale: Obsidian Publish is a first-party hosting service for publishing notes as a wiki or digital garden. Per the docs, you select the notes you want to share, press Publish, and the site is hosted at publish.obsidian.md, which covers selective in-app publishing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that internal links resolve and stay browsable on the published site, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Publish workflow.
